naqraa_features.description: A full messaging system supporting individual and group communication in a safe educational environment.
details: Instant messaging between students and teachers.
Create discussion rooms for projects and research.
Support for all file types (PDF, Docs, Media).

naqraa_features.title: Smart management for educational institutions
naqraa_features.description: A centralized tool to manage students, instructors, and learning content efficiently.
details: Organize curriculum and learning resources in a digital library.
Generate full performance analytics and reports.

naqraa_features.title: Learn for free and share knowledge
naqraa_features.description: Hundreds of free courses and educational materials at your fingertips.
details: Unlimited access to courses across many fields.
A large library of open-source references and files.
Publish and share your own educational content.

naqraa_features.title: Create research and projects professionally
naqraa_features.description: A collaboration tool built for academic writing and scientific research.
details: A writing engine with math and academic formula support.
